title: Taking up drums with no lessons
summary: He started drums at about 19 on a regular set and never took lessons.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Getting my first drums, with or without lessons

blocks.x: Oh, younger. Can you tell us about the first instrument you took up when you started in music?
Well, I already played drum. I always was a drummer, I mean.
How old were you when you started?
Oh, I was about 19 when I started.
You weren't just a little tiny kid then when you started in drums? Oh, no, no, no, no.
Have a regular drum set then?
I have a regular drum set.
No, I didn't take any lessons.
Just picked it up? I wanted to buy it.
